body.name: Frostlight Norman Nasal Helm
body.description: A fierce helm wrought from Froststone Ingots, merging the glacial force of the frozen abyss with the primal fury of its bearer.

body.name: Frostlight Oracle Robe
body.description: A flowing robe imbued with the frost of ancient realms, enhancing the wearer’s mystical presence with an ethereal chill.

body.name: Frostlight Plate Boots
body.description: Provides formidable protection, powered by the icy essence of the frozen abyss, though their clunkiness might slow you down a bit.

body.name: Frostlight Plate Pants
body.description: Sturdy plate pants forged from froststone ore, integrating the icy resilience of the frozen abyss into every plate and rivet.

body.name: Frostlight Riveted Gloves
body.description: Riveted with enchanted froststone, these gloves offer a seamless blend of the abyss's icy power and rugged durability.

body.name: Frostlight Rugged Boots
body.description: Combining thick leather and compact fur lining, these boots are infused with froststone’s chilling essence, offering both warmth and formidable durability.

body.name: Frostlight Runestone Gloves
body.description: These leather gloves, inlaid with froststone facets, offer a perfect blend of flexibility and the frigid power of mystical frozen ice.

body.name: Frostlight Spear
body.description: This spear combines the piercing power of a traditional spear with the icy might of the frozen abyss, making each attack chillingly effective.

body.name: Frostlight Trousers
body.description: Woven from light, enchanted fabric, these trousers are permeated with infinite freeze, offering both dexterity and the relentless chill of the glacial depths.

body.name: Frostlight War Maul
body.description: A War Maul forged from refined Froststone. The frozen head is strong enough to shatter any metal, and its icy chill seeps into the wielder’s hands. Thick gloves are essential to wield it.

body.name: Frostlight Warden Outfit
body.description: An ensemble that blends the resilience of the frozen abyss with the natural agility of the wilderness, offering a balance of strength and flexibility.

body.name: Frostlight Wizard Hat
body.description: An exquisite creation fashioned from Froststone Powder, combining the chilling power of the frozen abyss with arcane elegance.

body.name: Frozen Heart
body.description: From the lifeless blue heart of the already deceased Wendigo, emanates a chilling aura of ruthless death, pulsating with a faint heartbeat.

body.name: Frozen Iron Key
body.description: A weathered iron key encased in frost, hinting at locked mysteries buried in the coldest reaches.

body.name: Gallant Outfit
body.description: An attire crafted for courtly feasts and ceremonies. With puffed sleeves and tooled leather decorations, it gives a more splendid impression.
